title: Machine-check DM-DPP-01 precursor vs mature Dpp mobility factors (0.61 / 0.78)
instructions: Read the mature-chain and precursor lengths directly from sequences/sequence_links.json and encode the registered DM-DPP-01 arithmetic without changing the locked prediction registry.
Prove the stated mobility and length-scale factors within explicit tolerances in a standalone Lean file with zero sorry declarations.
If Lean is unavailable in the environment, create the file plus a Python cross-check and mark the fixer result blocked on kernel verification rather than claiming Lean success.

validators.name: No sorry term in Lean certificate
argv: import re; from pathlib import Path; s=Path('morphoeval/lean/loops/Loop_prediction_DM_DPP_01_dpp_mobility_ratio.lean').read_text(); s=re.sub(r'--.*', '', s); assert not re.search(r'(?<![A-Za-z_])sorry(?:Ax)?(?![A-Za-z_])', s); print('no sorry term')
